update.title: Made Desktop HUD profiles define complete scenes
update.summary: Moved each element’s renderer, data source, presentation, and geometry into layout profiles, allowing a profile switch to replace the complete HUD composition.

blocks.body:
## Let profiles define the elements

The main configuration selects profiles through `startup_profiles`, while each layout file carries the element records needed to build its scene. Type-specific settings such as renderer, provider, source, and opacity live beside position and size instead of being split across separate configuration layers.

Loading a profile therefore creates its content and its arrangement from the same document.

blocks.code:
name: default
elements:
  - id: cpu-gauge
    type: graph
    renderer: gauge
    renderer_config:
      min_value: 0
      max_value: 100
      label: CPU
    provider:
      type: command
      interval_ms: 2000
    position: {x: 50, y: 50}
    size: {width: 150, height: 150}
    opacity: 0.8
blocks.description: A profile carries the renderer, provider, presentation, and geometry needed to construct an element.

blocks.body:
## Switch or combine complete profiles

Switching profiles removes the active non-trait elements and constructs the selected profile’s element set. Additive loading combines multiple profiles by element ID, with definitions from later profiles replacing duplicates.

Startup profiles, the `--profile` and `--add` command-line options, and the profile API expose the same composition model for launch-time and runtime control.
